recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapters close with a roll-call summary naming every case in sequence then restating the thesis, fifteen times
instances: Jericho's tower cannot carry the whole history of war. Uruk's tablets cannot serve as a register of suffering.
The Sheffield letters place a human voice at the beginning of this chain, while the German schedules disclose...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Paragraphs terminate on a symmetrical two-clause antithesis joined by a semicolon or 'while'
instances: Material conditions create possibilities; people and institutions give those possibilities direction.
One makes relationships visible through story; the other makes procedure visible through repetition.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Every chapter installs a designated 'rival interpretation' section announced in almost the same words
instances: A rival interpretation begins from a powerful intuition...
A rival interpretation gives the map a narrower role.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Each artifact introduced then immediately disclaimed as non-transparent
instances: An expedition report is not a transparent count of violence.
Fulcher's providential sequence and Raymond's spectacular image are not transparent windows onto the event.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Rhetorical question as the hinge between sections
instances: How did local experience become part of an industrial system planned elsewhere?
What kind of order did professional policing promise, and for whom?

summary: Disciplined, learned; thesis honoured in every chapter; evidentiary specificity high; cost is architectural monotony: artifact, what it can show, what it cannot, rival interpretation, roll-call summary; paired antitheses and epistemic disclaimers past persuasion; labelled list in ch8; spelling drift.
